# Agent HUD 0.4.34-beta.1
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.4 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
If the required iPhone version is not yet on the App Store, cross-device features require the corresponding TestFlight version.
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
- Include recorded OpenCode, Pi and other client usage in token statistics. - Keep manual client selections across refreshes and show cards with historical usage. - Open the relevant client statistics from shared quota alerts. - Use the reported reset time for OpenCode Go quota countdowns.
Agent HUD 0.4.29 supports the App Store iPhone app 1.3. This Mac release predates in-app updates; download it from the release page.
